sound_replay.method:
Compare tick-indexed arcade sound state and VIC registers on a live replay.

Host PC observations only: no guest code, registers, clocks or sound are patched.
CPU timestamps can differ; this checks the values produced at each logical tick.

limitations: Single saved route and NTSC VICE; no physical hardware test or listening claim
Small average gain, not fixed 30 Hz pacing or perceptible flicker proof
Partial poses remain and Inky partial/ink-colour mismatch counts increase
Maximum native refresh grows; some normal-ghost pointer reads are slower from page placement
Smoke forces all three intermission levels; not a full unaided playthrough
Observed stack writes are not worst-case bounds
